sections.title: My family

q.prompt: Which word means “the woman who is your mum”?
q.reason: “mother” means the woman who is your mum.

options.fb: “sister” means a girl in your family, like you.
“father” means the man who is your dad.

captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 2. In this lesson: My family.
Name family members and say who they are.
Here are some new words. Mother. The woman who is your mum. Father.
The man who is your dad. Sister. A girl in your family, like you. Listen and say them.
mother
father
sister.
And some more words. Brother. A boy in your family, like you. Baby.
A very young child. Grandma. Your mum's or dad's mother. Listen and say them. brother
baby
grandma.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: the woman who is your mum?
Now some grammar: This is and These are.
Use ‘this is’ for one person and ‘these are’ for two or more people.
For example: This is my sister. For example: These are my brothers.
Now listen, and read along. Meet Lin's family. Hello! I am Lin. I am six.
This is my mother. She is a teacher. This is my father. He is a cook.
These are my brothers, Tao and Ben. They are eight. This is our baby, Mei.
She is very small!
Another question. The video will stop. How old is Lin?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like mother, father, sister.
You practised this is and these are. And you read Meet Lin's family.
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!

sections.title: Rooms in my home

q.prompt: Which word means “the room where you cook”?
q.reason: “kitchen” means the room where you cook.

options.fb: “bathroom” means the room where you wash.
“bedroom” means the room where you sleep.

captions: Hello, and welcome to Camday English, Stage 2. In this lesson: Rooms in my home.
Name rooms and things at home and say where things are.
Here are some new words. Kitchen. The room where you cook. Bedroom.
The room where you sleep. Bathroom. The room where you wash. Listen and say them.
kitchen
bedroom
bathroom.
And some more words. Garden. A place outside with grass and flowers. Door.
You open it to go into a room. Window. Glass in a wall – you can see out.
Listen and say them. garden
door
window.
Time for a question. The video will stop. Which word means: the room where you cook?
Now some grammar: in and on and under.
Use ‘in’, ‘on’ and ‘under’ to say where something is.
For example: The cat is on the bed. For example: The ball is under the table.
Now listen, and read along. Where is Teddy? Sam can't find Teddy.
Is Teddy in the kitchen? No. Is Teddy in the bathroom? No. Sam goes into the bedroom.
Teddy is under the bed! Now Teddy is on the bed with Sam.
Another question. The video will stop. Who can't find Teddy?
Well done! Today you learned new words, like kitchen, bedroom, bathroom.
You practised in and on and under. And you read Where is Teddy?
Now try the practice questions. See you next time!
